context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on product strategy
purpose: Teach: 通路/通話/品種/実体/原点/ネーム/努める/写し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 商品ネーム、原点を忘れるな。
lines.en: Product names—don't lose sight of where they come from.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate opening. The words carry weight without rushing. Slight pause before the second clause. Quiet authority: the voice of someone who has seen many mistakes made this way.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。品種ごとの実体を、毎週通話で確認しています。
lines.en: Yes. We confirm the specifics of each product line every week in our calls.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Earnest attention to detail in the delivery. Shows he's listening and taking action. Steady eye-contact level—reassuring without being defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 改善に努めるのは結構だが、通路の利便性も忘れずに。
lines.en: Improving is good, but don't overlook how customers actually move through the aisles.
lines.style: Gentle redirection, not criticism. Slight emphasis on 「通路」 to bring focus back to the practical reality. Patient tone—guiding toward a fuller picture, not correcting a failure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しております。指摘の写しを、社内に展開します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure your points are shared with the team.
lines.style: Prompt, respectful, efficient. No embellishment. A slight lift on 「承知」 showing he's absorbing and will act. Professional warmth—showing he respects the guidance enough to take it seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Brief, satisfied. A quiet nod in the voice. The kind of approval that closes the circle and sends the other person away feeling seen.
